mapper.select: SELECT E.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NAME, E.DEPT_NO, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NO, P.POSITION_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE E JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO JOIN POSITION P ON E.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO WHERE E.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NO DESC, E.EMP_NAME
